meta.title: Skill manager
meta.description: Adds a Skills row to the sidebar's global entry list. One install button: pick a skill archive (zip / tar.gz / tgz / tar.bz2 / tar.xz) or a bare SKILL.md, and it unpacks into ~/.dsh/skills immediately, replacing a same-name skill — no names, no checkboxes. SKILL.md may sit at the archive root or inside its single top folder. Skills are grouped by root, user skills delete behind a confirmation.
